description: This file contains test scripts for verifying Git configuration behavior related to the core.hooksPath variable. It sets up hooks, tests different configurations of core.hooksPath, and verifies the correct behavior of Git commands in those scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion with a provided description and commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Performs a git commit test to verify hook behavior under different configurations.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Writes a script to a specified location, used for setting up test hooks.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output during tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
